items.title: Senior Frontend Developer
items.description: Leading a team of four front-end engineers building the company's design system and the core web platform behind its customer dashboard. I own the front-end architecture, review every pull request and work closely with design and product to turn rough ideas into shipped features every sprint.
highlights: Raised the main app's Lighthouse performance score from 62 to 98 by moving to server rendering, code splitting and image optimisation
Designed and documented a component library of 60+ components now used across 5 products, cutting new-screen build time by about 40%
Set up visual regression testing with Storybook and Chromatic, so UI bugs are caught before they reach production
Mentored two junior developers who were both promoted within a year

items.title: Full-stack Developer
items.description: Joined as the third engineer and helped grow a B2B SaaS product from an early prototype to 10,000 paying users. Worked across the whole stack: React on the front end, NestJS and PostgreSQL on the back end, and AWS for infrastructure.
highlights: Built a REST and webhook API that now serves over 1 million requests a day with 99.9% uptime
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker, taking deployments from a manual hour-long process to ten minutes
Designed the billing and subscription flow with Stripe, handling upgrades, refunds and invoices
Reduced the monthly AWS bill by 30% by right-sizing instances and adding caching with Redis

items.title: Junior Web Developer
items.description: Built marketing websites, landing pages and small e-commerce stores for more than 15 clients, from local shops to regional brands. This is where I learned to ship on tight deadlines and talk with clients directly.
highlights: Delivered 15+ responsive websites on time, most of them within two to three weeks
Built custom WordPress themes and plugins so clients could edit their own content
Improved page speed and SEO, helping one client double organic traffic in six months
